items.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to truce in Oleshky
items.description: Moscow and Kyiv both said they would observe a ceasefire from Tuesday in the Russian-occupied town in the southern Kherson region where trapped citizens are running out of food. US First Lady Melania Trump announced Friday that she had brokered the truce.

items.title: Russia's attacks on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, are intensifying. DW asked people on the ground what life is like
items.description: Russia's attacks on the Ukrainian capital are hitting harder and more frequently, making 2026 one of the long war's bloodiest years for Kyiv. DW asked people on the ground what life is like.

items.title: Israeli forces begin demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers shot dead
items.description: The soldiers were killed in an attack by two Palestinian gunmen at a checkpoint outside the West Bank city on Friday morning.

items.title: Every Day We 'Wake Up Poorer': Iranians Battle Economic Woes
items.description: Battered by mismanagement, sanctions, and war, Iran’s economy is in deep trouble. The cost-of-living crisis is forcing people to change what they eat, how they socialize, and what they can afford to do with their lives.

items.title: West Bank: Guterres alarmed as Israel imposes sweeping closures after deadly Hebron attack
items.description: The UN said on Friday it was “extremely alarmed” by intensifying violence in the occupied West Bank, as Israel moved to seal off the territory following a deadly attack on its soldiers in Hebron.

items.title: Putin Says Renewed Peace Talks Must Focus on Security for Russia, Ukraine and Europe Overall
items.description: The president said that Russia remains intent on resolving the conflict once and for all rather than agreeing to a short-lived ceasefire with Kyiv.

items.title: What we know about war plans that Trump and Netanyahu are drawing up
items.description: Could the U.S. and Israel be on the verge of launching a new attack on Iran? President Trump and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have been suggesting that's on the table.
